notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - OPTIMIZATION
notes.notes:
🚀 [b]Performance and Optimization[/b]
✅ [b]CPU Optimization[/b] – NPC animations have been optimized to reduce CPU usage, significantly improving performance, especially in the Istanbul map.
✅ [b]Disk Space Optimization[/b] – Game file size has been reduced by 50%, taking up less storage.
✅ [b]Faster Game Startup[/b] – The game now starts much faster, and level loading times have been reduced.
✅ [b]Reduced VRAM Requirements[/b] – Optimizations have lowered VRAM usage, resolving VRAM-related crashes.
✅ [b]RAM Usage Optimization[/b] – Memory usage has been improved for better efficiency.
✅ [b]GPU Optimization[/b] – Lighting and shadows have been optimized, reducing GPU load.

🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
✅ [b]Fatal Error Fixes[/b] – Various Fatal Error issues have been resolved, providing a more stable gameplay experience.

notes.title: Compass of Destiny: Istanbul - Version 2.1.2 Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, Adventurers![/b]

We’re bringing a fresh wave of excitement to the magical streets of Istanbul! With version 2.1.2 of Compass of Destiny: Istanbul, we’ve added several thrilling new features and improvements to enhance your gameplay. Here’s what you can expect:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/35df96ebae7965de38dbdca2296ef67041f93c6e.png[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[olist]
[*][b]Bug Fixes and Performance Enhancements:[/b] We fixed some bugs reported by you and significantly improved the game’s performance. There was a considerable performance loss, especially on Ultra settings, and we applied special optimizations for this level.
[*][b]Map and Level Adjustments:[/b] We made adjustments to the map for a smoother gameplay experience in various parts of Istanbul. Specifically, certain pathways and the lighting that marks these routes were revised.
[*][b]Lighting and Shadowing:[/b] All lighting in Istanbul and the realms of “fıtrat” has been reworked for each graphical setting to achieve a more consistent visual experience. In addition, the new lighting method has greatly improved performance.
[*][b]The Residences of the Polish Envoy and Köse Ali Pasha:[/b] We enhanced the interiors of the residences of the Polish Envoy and Köse Ali Pasha, and also updated the lighting methods to make these areas feel more immersive.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/393aaaec0a20da1ac01012fac4b9183016f01ea3.png[/img]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[olist]
[*][b]Dark Shadowing Issue on Medium and Low Settings:[/b] When playing on Medium and Low settings, the "Effect Quality" option caused all shadows to appear excessively dark. This problem has been resolved with the new lighting method.
[*][b]Tahtacılar Mission: [/b]During the Tahtacılar mission, if you didn’t interact as required, the mission would fail. Later, if you returned to that area for another mission, the failed Tahtacılar mission would reactivate. Although it didn’t freeze the game, it did disrupt the flow. This issue has been fixed.
[*][b]Fıtrat Enemies:[/b] Some enemies in Fıtrat could fall off platforms, which could freeze the game. This issue has been resolved.
[/olist]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS V0.5 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been over a month since our release, and during this time, we've made many improvements based on your feedback. We've implemented various changes, including bug fixes and new mechanics, making it the largest update we've done so far.

We will continue to improve the game and implement new features and bug fixes. Of course, your feedback is crucial during this period. If you want to report any issues you encounter more quickly, you can email us at [b]developer@5deniz.com[/b].

Here are all the changes that have been made with the [b]v0.5_201023[/b] update:

[b][h1]Visual Improvements:[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] The mission screen interface has been updated, and UX has been improved.
[*] Fixed the glare issue when changing the character's skin tone in the character creation screen.
[*] Updated the cutscene for the Woodworkers' mission.
[*] Changed the character animation in the inventory screen.
[*] Changed the shapes of the Health and Soul bars to spheres.
[*] Updated the layout of the ability screen interface.
[*] Simplified the design of the Soul gauge and added it to the death screen.
[*] Added environment sound specific to the Shishane district.
[*] Renewed the map.
[*] Added a sound effect when performing the sliding move.
[*] Added a sliding rope sound.
[*] Updated the animation and sound effects for obtaining or failing a mission.
[*] Added a tool model for sliding ropes.
[*] Updated the character's sliding rope animation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/665644e0276970c598a3602dde87d2de664ab395.gif[/img]
[*] Updated ability icons.
[/list]

[b][h1]Mechanical Improvements:[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] Nature quests are now added to your quest library as soon as you obtain the compass.
[*] Added a brief information text about the character's past to the character creation screen.
[*] Taking fall damage when falling from a height.
[*] Added a panel in the inventory screen that specifies item attributes.
[*] Added the ability for the compass to slow down enemies. You need to wait for a certain time to use this ability again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/218eaae8920fb5457384f01ee999a1329f3834f6.gif[/img]
[*] Added a new ability to the sword weapon group. This ability freezes all nearby enemies and attacks them with a sword.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/75a2dad8e889935d6a9065856aca196b3e7daaf4.gif[/img]
[*] Added a new ability to the shield weapon group, allowing us to throw the shield to hit and damage surrounding enemies before it returns to our character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/eb3792908da81f3b29e75fbcf90bfaa6b303c19e.gif[/img]
[*] Introduced the ability to cancel an ability during its use in the ability system.
[*] Can now spend collected "Essence of Nature" items in the realm of the dead.
[*] More discoverable items are now available in every corner of Istanbul.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/76dff73834d08c8eb4ef458e974004d23aa52197.gif[/img]
[*] Added more sliding ropes to rooftops.
[*] Added the mechanic to pick up and throw explosive and poison barrels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/791c3a6d0862de2c2c735931f5d36bc3c8737b0e.gif[/img]
[*] Added enemy spiders to the game.
[*] Added draggable boxes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43641816/4d33bdf7db08f00ec6015ac2e304a3c503075c60.gif[/img]
[*] Added the ability to initiate a dialogue with the compass.
[*] Introduced a cinematic skip feature.
[/list]

[b][h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed issues with objects obstructing the camera when entering the area where the slaves are held on the ship.
[*] Resolved an issue that prevented weapon change keys from working while running in combat mode.
[*] Fixed the issue that prevented us from breaking objects that should be breakable with a bow.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the screen to turn white in unknown areas on the fast map screen.
[*] The fast map screen used to remain on screen even when the game was paused, and this issue has been fixed.
[*] Fixed a bug that disrupted the game's camera due to a choice in the Woodworkers' mission.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the ability mode to get stuck when using a controller.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character reacted as if picking up an item for the first time when removing equipment from the character in the inventory screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused quest markers to appear during cinematics.
[*] Fixed an issue where the in-game interface was not hidden in some places.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the dialogue to continue when the game was paused during the compass's conversation.
[*] Fixed a bug that falsely detected the character as being outside the area when using stairs.
[/list]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS V0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We have successfully passed the first weekend in the Early Access phase. We continue to work on improvements by closely monitoring the feedback you provided through comments and plan to leave all the glitches behind in the full version.

With the [b]v0.1_180923[/b] update, the changes and bug fixes we made are as follows:

[h1]Visual Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Excessive glare in the Prologue section has been corrected.
[*] The lighting of the balcony of St. Andrea Castle has been changed.
[*] The handrail animation on which our character leans in St. Andrea Castle was flawed, and a minor visual adjustment has been made.
[/list]

[h1]Mechanical Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] "Quick use" slots are now being saved.
[*] Texts that should appear above characters' heads now appear in the correct places.
[*] Manual save points have been added to Istanbul.
[*] The ability to exit menus with the ESC button has been added.
[*] A shortcut to gain Souls by using "Essence of Nature" in the afterlife has been added.
[*] You are no longer punished with death when falling below the Fates.
[*] The sound and damage of the poison barrel have been adjusted; the sound is now at a more comfortable level, and the damage and duration have been reduced.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] When placing another consumable item on top of quick-use slots, the item that was previously in that slot was changing to the first slot. This has been fixed.
[*] The camera system was breaking when picking locks with a lockpick. This has been fixed.
[*] Speech bubbles were not stopping when the game was paused. This has been fixed.
[*] In the dialogues with Bergüzar in Galata, there was a sudden FPS drop issue, which has now been resolved.
[*] In the rooms of Venice Castle, some text bubbles were appearing in the wrong places on the "Memory Mirrors." This issue has been resolved.
[*] Item prices were displayed incorrectly on the three-dimensional trade screen. This issue has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Day!
notes.notes:
After long efforts and hard work, we have finally released Compass of the Destiny: Istanbul, which we developed with great care!

You can now access the game on Steam and get it with a special 20% discount for the launch! We are looking forward to your valuable reviews!
